facility.name: Rising Star Academy, LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 920 PEEK RD, KATY, TX, 77450

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A fire inspection has not been conducted since July 5, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 4 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain proof of education documentation that has been translated into english.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: 1 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain proof of education.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 out of 10 children's files evaluated did not contain an emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: 1 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain current training in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: 1 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain current training in Pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support child/caregiver ratios are not being maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support a violation of this standard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The emergency preparedness plan did not include the following procedures:    Communication   How staff will evacuate and relocate with essential documentation.   How staff will continue to care for children until each child has been released.   How the operation will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Children were observed sitting in the high chairs without the safety straps secured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation it was determined a caregiver used prohibited punishment by grabbing a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: Alcohol wipes in the first aid kit located in the office and Bus #2 were expired. This was corrected when the director removed the expired alcohol wipes and replaced them with new ones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 1 out of 10 staff files evaulated did not contain a signed affadavit for employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors: The first aid kit located on Bus #2 did not have scissiors. This was corrected when the director placed a pair of scissors in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Requirements - Submit All Identifying Information: A background check was re-submitted for a caregiver without all required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Requirements - Submit All Identifying Information (26 TAC §745.619)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product safety recall list has not been certified annually. The last date of certification was on 5/18/2021.    Note: Correction was made during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three children files reviewed were missing the following from their admission forms:  -Special needs acknowledgment  -Address of emergency contact person  -Phone number to school for a school age child    Note: Correction was made during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The most recent fire inspection report was not available for review. The last inspection was conducted on 1/14/2022.    Note: The Director paid the annual fire inspection fee to the Fire Marshall during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: An employee's file reviewed is missing 11 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: A child in the 2yr. to 3yr. old classroom was not signed in on the electronic tablet or paper copy of the attendance log.     Note: Correction was made during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: A caregiver in charge of a group of children 14m to 22m was not aware of the ages of the children in their care. Also, a caregiver in charge of a group of children 2yr. to 3yr. olds were not aware of the ages of the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: One caregiver was not aware of the number of children in their care. The caregiver was asked the number of children in their care and looked to the caregiver in charge and asked how many they had. The caregiver then stated multiple times that there were 9 children in care. When asked where the 9th child was the caregiver then    counted and stated there were 8
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: One caregiver in charge of a group of children 3-4 yrs old was not aware of the ages of the children in their care. After being asked, the caregiver guessed the ages of the oldest and youngest and stated they were not sure and did not know.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: 4 children were observed to be placed in a bean shaped table with bucket seats. The seat straps were observed to be removed and were not used.    NOTE: Safety straps were ordered during the inspection. Expected delivery Oct. 3-11th
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not use good judgement when the caregiver aggressively grabbed a child repeatedly because the child kept getting up to avoid being in time-out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not use positive methods of discipline and guidance when caregiver stated the reason for discipling a child was in effort to prepare the child for school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(B))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: An employee has not completed any hours of pre-service training. There is no documentation of completed training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: Two caregivers who transports children has not completed 2 hours of transportation training,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The transportation logs are missing emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.    Note: This information was added to the transportation logs during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Four personnel records reviewed are not being maintained and complete. The following are missing from one or more records:  1. Staff Driver's License  2. Orientation Training  3. Pre-Service Training  4. Child Care Center Personnel Information Record Form 2947  5. Notarized Affidavit  6. Proof of Education
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There are three outlet covers missing in the 3y and 4y old classroom.    Also, there is one outlet cover missing in the 4y old classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm does not work on one of the buses used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: One of the transportation vans being used to transport children does not have a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: One of the transportation vehicles does not have a complete first aid kit. The following items are missing: (1) Adhesive tape; (2) Antiseptic solution or wipes; (3) Cotton balls; (4) Scissors; (5) Thermometer, preferably non-glass; and (6) Tweezers
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three children records evaluated were missing the address for their emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation does not have a playground checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The Director has not completed 30 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The transportation logs are missing parent s names and telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for  each child being transported.    Note: The information was added to the transportation logs during the insepction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregiver files evaluated does not have first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has not practiced lock down drills at least four times a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation has not practiced severe weather drills at least four times a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: An employee who has been employed for a month has not completed orientation training. There is no documentaton training has been completed in the employees file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregiver files evaluated does not have cpr training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There is no documentation fire drills are conducted monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: The current director has not provided documentation of their renewed director credentials. Their current credentials expired on 6/28/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days: The operation failed to notify parents of all children enrolled about a safe sleep deficiency that was cited during the last inspection conducted on 5/24/2022.     Notification was supposed to be sent no later than May 29, 2022.    Note: Notification to parents of all children enrolled was sent via the procare system during this follow-up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days (26 TAC §746.311(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 4 month old was observed asleep in a crib with a blanket being used as a covering.     Another crib was observed with a blanket and a boppy pillow in it. There was no child in the crib at the time.     Note: A photos were taken. The caregiver removed the blankets and boppy pillow from the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A child walked out of their classroom to the front office during the inspection without any supervision. The child is in the 4y to 6y old classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: The person that prepares the food was observed serving children food for lunch without any gloves on their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A 6 month old child was observed sitting in a high chair without the safety straps fastened.    Note: The caregiver fastened the straps when addressed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation inspection, it was determined a caregiver was observed on video footage wiping a table top down with soap and water and using the same towel to wipe three children hands and faces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
